rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is capable and efficient.

example.english: They are very capable and efficient at their work.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 nang4 gon3

rows.note: Use this when capable emphasizes being clever or skilled at something.

example.english: My younger sister is capable and knows how to build a computer herself.
example.traditional: 阿妹好叻，識得自己砌電腦。
example.jyutping: aa3 mui6 hou2 lek1 sik1 dak1 zi6 gei2 cai3 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this when capable means proven to be good enough or able to handle the job.

example.english: I know you are capable of handling this job.
example.traditional: 呢單嘢交畀你做，我知你一定掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 je5 gaau1 bei2 nei5 zou6 ngo5 zi1 nei5 jat1 ding6 dim6
